title.original: CaTE Data Curation for Trustworthy AI
title.zh: 可信赖的人工智能CaTE数据管理
title.en: CaTE Data Curation for Trustworthy AI

inclusion_reason.zh: CaTE 将可信数据筛选的步骤、分支、前提和工具实现组织为可裁剪工作流，为团队提供治理流程基础设施。
inclusion_reason.en: CaTE organizes trustworthy curation steps, branches, prerequisites, and tool implementations into a tailorable workflow, providing governance-process infrastructure.

abstract.zh: CaTE 把可信 AI 的数据筛选阶段整理为一套可执行指南，按步骤说明不同方法的前提、优缺点、产物和可用开源工具。
abstract.en: CaTE turns trustworthy-AI data curation into an operational guide whose steps document prerequisites, trade-offs, outputs, alternative branches, and relevant open-source tools.

problem.zh: 开发团队面对分散的数据治理与可信性方法时，缺少贯穿数据筛选生命周期的共同语言和决策顺序。
problem.en: Development teams face fragmented governance and trustworthiness practices without a shared vocabulary or decision sequence spanning the curation lifecycle.

approach.zh: 报告综合学术文献与工具实践，定义数据、筛选阶段和可信性，再枚举核心步骤及存在不同选择时的并行路径。
approach.en: The report synthesizes academic and tooling literature, defines data, curation, and trustworthiness, then enumerates core steps and parallel paths where multiple choices are viable.

system_design.zh: 指南以决策工作流组织：每个节点记录输入条件、实施动作、预期结果、风险与工具实现，使团队可按项目约束裁剪流程。
system_design.en: The guide is structured as a decision workflow: each node records preconditions, actions, outcomes, risks, and tool implementations so teams can tailor the path to project constraints.

key_results.zh: 主要产出是覆盖多种可信性目标的连贯实践地图，而非一个通过统一实验比较得出的性能结论。
key_results.en: Its principal result is a coherent practice map across multiple trustworthiness goals rather than a performance claim established through a common experiment.

limitations.zh: 指南属于文献综合，缺少跨行业的统一实证验证；法律要求、组织能力和工具生态变化都可能使具体步骤需要重新解释。
limitations.en: As a literature synthesis, it lacks uniform cross-industry validation; legal duties, organizational capacity, and changing tools can all require reinterpretation of individual steps.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件与基线均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未给出可安全转录的结果数字，表格明细与部署配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, and baselines come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; the abstract provides no result number safe to transcribe, and table details plus deployment configuration still require full-text audit.
